messages:
Maya (eng-runtime): Heads up — we're seeing higher p99s on a subset of customer routes after the kernel fallback rollout. Can we add a per-route KPI dashboard that helps attribute token-level latency between kernel_compute, KV cache, and batching/backpressure?

Tom R: +1. Which metrics do we already emit that we can reuse?

Alex: We already emit `route.token_latency_ms` with a `stage` tag (kv_lookup/kernel/dispatch/postproc) and `route.kv_cache.hit` (0/1). There's also `kernel.fallback.count` per model_variant but it's not surfaced on console panels yet.

Maya (eng-runtime): For the console view I want: p50/p95/p99 token latency, throughput (req/s), error rate, kv hit rate, kernel.fallback rate, and a stacked waterfall (kv_lookup / kernel_compute / batching_wait / postproc) for the chosen percentile.

Leah: UX idea — small per-route card: sparkline + numbers (p50/p95/p99) with a delta vs baseline. Clicking the card opens waterfall percentile selector (p50/p95/p99) and a breakdown by kernel_choice.

Tom R: Perf regressions we've seen are sometimes caused by async batching backpressure. We should surface `batch.wait_ms` and `batch.size` distributions and a `router.batching.backpressure` counter to correlate.

Maya (eng-runtime): Instrumentation asks: 1) attach `kernel_choice` tag to all token-stage metrics (so we can slice by chosen kernel vs fallback). 2) emit `token.stage_duration_ms` as a histogram with stage tag and explicit buckets [0.1,0.5,1,2,5,10,50,200,500].

Alex: Quick pseudo for metric emission (to copy into code review):
```
emit.histogram("token.stage_duration_ms", ms, {route, model, stage, kernel_choice})
emit.count("kernel.fallback.count", 1, {route, model, kernel_choice})
emit.histogram("router.batch.wait_ms", wait_ms, {route, batch_size})
```

perf-bot: [alert] p99 > 400ms on route `dialogue_v2` (last 10m)

Maya (eng-runtime): Dashboard layout suggestion: top row = per-route summary cards (p50/p95/p99, throughput, errors), middle row = waterfall percentile selector + breakdown by kernel_choice, bottom row = time series for kv hit rate and kernel.fallback rate. Also surface sampling policy (1% global, 100% on SLO routes). :eyes: 

Leah: Add a drilldown link to perf traces / flamegraphs (e.g., perf-trace://trace-id) so SREs can jump from a p99 spike to a trace.

Tom R: Plan: I'll land telemetry changes (PR) to attach kernel_choice and stage_histogram — ETA 1 week. After metrics are available, I will build the dashboard panels and wire alerts — ETA 3 days.

Maya (eng-runtime): Suggested alerts: p99 delta > 20% vs baseline OR kernel.fallback.rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Also add an automatic note to the route card when kernel fallback > 0 for > 10m.

Alex: Adding a TODO in #eng-releases for release notes and a short blurb for the console changelog.

deploy-bot: deployment started for `telemetry/attach-kernel-tag` by Alex — build #438

Tom R: I'll watch the deploy and run a targeted load test on dialogue_v2 once metrics land.

Maya (eng-runtime): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
